name: IMGN151
sort_evidence: NCT07024784 Phase 2 recruiting tests IMGN151 (INN opugotamig olatansine), a biparatopic FR-alpha ADC distinct from Elahere and with no book row (https://www.adcreview.com/drugmap/imgn151/).

trials.title: A Study to Assess Change in Disease Activity and Adverse Events in Adult Participants With Gynecologic Cancers Receiving Intravenous Infusion of IMGN151 as Monotherapy or in Combination With Other Therapies
First in Human Study of IMGN151 in Recurrent Gynaecological Cancers
